  log "Rotating keys for user: $user ($f)"
  rotated_any=1

    [ -s "$f" ] && log "  Would backup to $backup_root/$user/authorized_keys"
    log "  Would truncate and write notice to $f"
    log "  Would fix perms on $sshdir (700) and $f (600)"
    continue
  fi

  if [ -s "$f" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$backup_root/$user"
    cp -p -- "$f" "$backup_root/$user/authorized_keys"
  fi

  {
    printf '# SSH keys were rotated on %s\n' "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"
    printf '# Please re-add your public key or contact an administrator.\n'
  } > "$f"

  chmod 600 "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
  chown "$user":"$user" "$sshdir" 2>/dev/null || true
  chmod 700 "$sshdir" 2>/dev/null || true

if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
  log "Would remove backups older than ${RETENTION_DAYS} days from /root/ssh-keys-backup"
else
  find /root/ssh-keys-backup -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -mtime +"${RETENTION_DAYS}" -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
fi

if [ "$rotated_any" = "0" ]; then
  log "No authorized_keys files found under /home. Nothing to do."
fi

exit 0
